brief.topic: Dual-track classification / routing (T0.1) and combination-modeling operators (T3.2) for ZKnowledgeCompounding: calibrated semantic routing, constrained structured generation, multi-source synthesis into higher-level models, hierarchical graph community summaries, incremental knowledge updates, and local/offline execution on a PostgreSQL backend

criteria.question: Does it classify or route inputs into categories with confidence, thresholds, or abstention?
Does it guarantee constrained/structured generation (schema, regex, grammar, literal)?
Does it combine multiple sources into higher-level summaries, models, or synthesized answers?
Does it build a graph or hierarchical community structure to organise context?
Does it support incremental updates or deletion without full re-indexing?
Can it run locally or offline with local models/embeddings?
Which storage backends are supported, especially PostgreSQL?
